## Client Backstory:

**Sarah Chen**, 34, is a software engineer who recently relocated from San Francisco to Seattle for a prestigious job at a tech startup. She left behind her support network, including her younger sister Maya (her only family after their parents died in a car accident five years ago). Sarah has been struggling with perfectionism since childhood, when her immigrant parents pushed her to excel academically. She's been in a relationship with Marcus for three years, but it's become long-distance since her move. She experiences imposter syndrome at work, despite her achievements, and has been having panic attacks during important presentations. She hasn't been sleeping well in her new apartment, which faces a busy street, and has been drinking more wine than usual in the evenings.

## 100 Statements Sarah Might Make During Therapy:

1. "I keep telling myself I should be grateful for this opportunity, but I just feel empty inside."

2. "Every time my boss schedules a meeting, I immediately assume I'm getting fired."

3. "I had another panic attack during yesterday's sprint review - I had to pretend I was having connection issues and turn off my camera."

4. "Marcus says he's supportive, but I can hear the frustration in his voice when I cancel our video dates again."

5. "I've been having this recurring dream where I'm presenting code that turns into gibberish as I'm explaining it."

6. "My sister called last night crying about mom and dad, and I just... I couldn't comfort her. I felt nothing."

7. "I've been drinking a bottle of wine every night just to fall asleep, but then I wake up at 3 AM with my heart racing."

8. "Everyone at work seems so confident and put-together, and I feel like I'm constantly about to be exposed as a fraud."

9. "I haven't unpacked most of my boxes yet. It's been two months. I just can't seem to care."

10. "Sometimes I catch myself hoping I'll get sick so I have a legitimate excuse to miss work."

11. "I used to love coding, but now opening my laptop fills me with dread."

12. "I keep replaying that presentation from last week where I stumbled over my words - I'm sure everyone thinks I'm incompetent now."

13. "Maya asked me when I'm coming to visit, and I lied about being too busy because I can't handle seeing our parents' house right now."

14. "I've been ordering takeout every night because the thought of cooking for just myself feels pointless."

15. "My chest gets so tight during meetings that I feel like I'm suffocating."

16. "I saw a photo of my old team having drinks without me, and I cried for an hour."

17. "Marcus wants to plan a visit, but I keep making excuses because I don't want him to see how I'm living."

18. "I feel like I'm failing at everything - my job, my relationship, being a sister, taking care of myself."

19. "Sometimes I sit in the parking garage for 20 minutes before I can make myself go into the office."

20. "I know exercise would help, but I can't even get myself to walk around the block."

21. "My manager complimented my work yesterday, and all I could think was 'if only she knew how long it actually took me.'"

22. "I've been having these intrusive thoughts about crashing my car on the way to work - not suicidal, just... escapist."

23. "I feel guilty for being depressed when I have such a 'good' job and make good money."

24. "The sound of Slack notifications makes my stomach drop every single time."

25. "I used to call my mom every day after work, and now there's just... silence."

26. "I've started lying about having plans on weekends so my coworkers won't invite me to things."

27. "Sometimes I feel like I'm watching my life happen from outside my body."

28. "I know Marcus is going to leave me - why would anyone want to deal with this version of me?"

29. "I've been wearing the same three outfits on rotation because choosing clothes feels overwhelming."

30. "My neighbor introduced herself last week, and I almost had a panic attack just from that small interaction."

31. "I keep having this fear that I'll forget something crucial at work and cause a major system failure."

32. "Maya sent me a video of her daughter taking her first steps, and I felt nothing. What's wrong with me?"

33. "I've been keeping my camera off in meetings and blaming technical issues because I can't stand how exhausted I look."

34. "Sometimes I fantasize about just disappearing - not dying, just... not existing for a while."

35. "I used to be the person people came to for help, and now I can barely help myself."

36. "The therapist in San Francisco said I was making progress, but I feel like I've undone years of work in just two months."

37. "I wake up every morning disappointed that I have to face another day."

38. "My performance review is coming up, and I've already started drafting my resignation letter, just in case."

39. "I told Marcus I've been making friends here, but I haven't had a real conversation with anyone outside of work tasks."

40. "Sometimes I forget to eat until 4 PM and then just have crackers for dinner because nothing sounds good."

41. "I keep having this irrational fear that everyone at work has a group chat where they talk about how incompetent I am."

42. "My parents would be so disappointed if they could see me now - they sacrificed everything for my success."

43. "I've been avoiding LinkedIn because seeing other people's achievements makes me feel like a failure."

44. "The last time I felt genuinely happy was... I can't even remember."

45. "I know I should reach out to my old friends, but I don't want them to know I'm struggling."

46. "Sometimes I spend entire weekends in bed, just scrolling through my phone without really seeing anything."

47. "I've been having these weird physical symptoms - my jaw hurts from clenching it all day."

48. "Marcus asked if I'm seeing someone else because I've been so distant, and I couldn't explain that I'm just empty."

49. "I keep making stupid mistakes at work because I can't concentrate, which just confirms my worst fears about myself."

50. "The city is so gray and rainy - it feels like the weather matches my mood perfectly."

51. "I've been having nightmares about the car accident again, even though it's been five years."

52. "My team lead asked if I was okay yesterday, and I almost broke down in the middle of the office."

53. "I feel like I'm constantly performing 'being okay' and it's exhausting."

54. "Sometimes I Google 'signs of burnout' or 'quarter-life crisis' hoping to find some explanation that isn't just... me being broken."

55. "I've stopped checking my personal email because I can't handle any more responsibilities."

56. "The startup culture here is so intense - everyone works until 8 PM like it's normal."

57. "I keep thinking about how my parents never got to see me succeed, and now I'm not even succeeding."

58. "I've been using my lunch breaks to cry in my car."

59. "Maya asked me to be her daughter's godmother, and the responsibility of that terrifies me."

60. "I feel like I tricked everyone into thinking I'm competent, and now I'm trapped in this role I can't fulfill."

61. "Sometimes I feel this intense anger at my parents for dying and leaving us alone."

62. "I've been having these heart palpitations that make me think I'm having a heart attack."

63. "Marcus surprised me with a visit last month, and I spent the whole time pretending everything was fine. It was exhausting."

64. "I keep comparing myself to where I thought I'd be by now, and I fall short in every way."

65. "My old therapist's office felt safe - everything here feels threatening."

66. "I've been catastrophizing about every little mistake - like if I miss one semicolon, the entire company will fail."

67. "Sometimes I feel like I'm suffocating in my apartment, but going outside feels worse."

68. "I know I should be networking and making connections, but I can barely maintain the relationships I have."

69. "I've been having this recurring thought that I've peaked and it's all downhill from here."

70. "The other day, I couldn't remember if I had locked my car, and I checked six times."

71. "I feel guilty for taking up space in therapy when other people have 'real' problems."

72. "My hands shake during video calls, and I'm terrified someone will notice."

73. "I've been avoiding Maya's calls because hearing her voice reminds me of everything I've lost."

74. "Sometimes I think about quitting and moving back, but that feels like admitting failure."

75. "I used to have hobbies - I played guitar, I hiked, I cooked. Now I just exist."

76. "The pressure to be the 'diversity hire' who succeeds is crushing me."

77. "I keep having this dream where I show up to work and my access badge doesn't work anymore."

78. "Marcus mentioned moving here, and instead of feeling happy, I panicked about him seeing the real me."

79. "I've been taking sick days just to avoid particularly stressful meetings."

80. "Sometimes I feel like I'm living someone else's life - like the real me got lost somewhere along the way."

81. "I know caffeine makes my anxiety worse, but I'm drinking five cups a day just to function."

82. "My parents always said 'Chen's don't quit,' and I feel like I'm betraying their memory by struggling."

83. "I've been having these obsessive thoughts about whether I locked my apartment door."

84. "The thought of dating in a new city if Marcus and I break up is paralyzing."

85. "I feel like I'm constantly on the verge of tears, but I can't actually cry when I need to."

86. "Sometimes I wonder if I made a huge mistake leaving everything behind for this job."

87. "I've been procrastinating on important tasks and then staying up all night to finish them, which makes everything worse."

88. "My old team reached out about a position back in San Francisco, and I don't know if going back would be giving up or saving myself."

89. "I keep having this fear that I'll have a panic attack during an important client presentation."

90. "The last time I genuinely laughed was... I can't even remember. Everything feels forced."

91. "I've been avoiding grocery shopping because the fluorescent lights and crowds make me anxious."

92. "Sometimes I think my parents' death broke something in me that can't be fixed."

93. "I feel like I'm constantly apologizing for everything, even things that aren't my fault."

94. "Marcus says I've changed, and he's right - I don't recognize myself anymore."

95. "I've been having this recurring fear that I'll forget how to code in the middle of a project."

96. "The imposter syndrome is so bad that I've started documenting everything I do in case someone questions my work."

97. "I know I need help, but even being here feels like admitting I'm not strong enough."

98. "Sometimes I feel like I'm drowning in plain sight and no one notices."

99. "I keep thinking about what my therapist in San Francisco said about grief being non-linear, but this feels like I'm going backwards."

100. "I just want to feel like myself again, but I'm starting to wonder if that person still exists."
